list.name: device
list.label: Device
list.query: select case when name is null then device_id else name || '  ·  ' || device_id end as __text, device_id as __value from device order by name nulls last, device_id
list.definition: select case when name is null then device_id else name || '  ·  ' || device_id end as __text, device_id as __value from device order by name nulls last, device_id

targets.rawSql: select count(*) from device

panels.title: Reported < 2 h

targets.rawSql: select count(*) from fleet_now where silent_sec < 7200

panels.description: Devices heard from in the last two hours.

targets.rawSql: select count(*) from fleet_now where battery < 30

panels.title: Connect failures

targets.rawSql: select count(*) from connect_failure where $__timeFilter(ts)

panels.description: connect_failure events in the selected time range.

panels.title: Hook errors

targets.rawSql: select count(*) from hook_event where kind='error' and $__timeFilter(ts)

panels.description: Webhook deliveries Particle reported as failed in the selected time range.

panels.title: Log freshness

targets.rawSql: select extract(epoch from now() - max(last_seen)) from device

panels.description: Time since the newest event in the database. Grows if the SSE stream or the ingest stops.

panels.title: Fleet now

targets.rawSql:
select name, device_id, last_seen, silent_sec, status, fw_version, battery, vbat_idle, vbat_load,
       rsrp_dbm, sinr, band, operator, connect_attempts, connect_successes, success_pct, failures_24h, reed_closed
from fleet_now where device_id in ($device) order by last_seen desc

panels.description: Latest report from every device. Counters are lifetime totals; success_pct is successes/attempts over the device's whole life.

panels.title: Where the devices are
panels.description: Newest cell-tower geolocation per device (cloud/geolocation: Google's position for the serving cell, so a device sits at its tower, within accuracy_m). Colour: time since the device last reported - green under 8 h, red past 14 h (two missed 6-hourly reports). Hover for the details.

panels.title: Positions

targets.rawSql:
select label as device, lat, lng, accuracy_m, tower, cell_id, cached, fix_at, on_tower_since
from device_position join device_label using (device_id) where device_id in ($device) order by fix_at desc

panels.description: Latest fix per device. tower is mcc-mnc-lac-cid; on_tower_since is when the device last changed tower, so a stationary device shows its install date here.

panels.title: Geolocation fixes per day

targets.rawSql:
select $__timeGroupAlias(ts, 1d),
       case when cached then 'cached' else 'google lookup' end as metric, count(*)
from geolocation where $__timeFilter(ts) and device_id in ($device) group by 1, 2 order by 1

panels.description: Every connection yields one fix; 'google lookup' is a tower the device had not seen before (or one older than 90 days) - that is what costs a Geolocation API call.

panels.title: Online / offline

targets.rawSql:
select ts as time, label as device, status from device_status join device_label using (device_id)
where $__timeFilter(ts) and device_id in ($device) order by ts

panels.description: spark/status events. Devices sleep between reports, so 'offline' is the normal resting state; what matters is the cadence.

panels.title: RSRP (Device OS diagnostics)

targets.rawSql:
select ts as time, label as metric, rsrp_dbm from diagnostics join device_label using (device_id)
where $__timeFilter(ts) and device_id in ($device) and rsrp_dbm is not null order by ts

panels.description: Serving-cell RSRP as reported at each cloud handshake. Below about -110 dBm Cat-M1 attach gets slow.

targets.rawSql:
select ts as time, label as metric, sinr from rf_survey join device_label using (device_id)
where $__timeFilter(ts) and device_id in ($device) order by ts

panels.title: Attach time per cycle (Δ modemSearchSec)

targets.rawSql:
select ts as time, label as metric, d_search_sec from telemetry_delta join device_label using (device_id)
where $__timeFilter(ts) and device_id in ($device) order by ts

panels.description: Seconds the modem spent searching for a network in each wake cycle. modemSearchSec is a lifetime counter; this is its difference between consecutive reports (null across a reboot).

targets.rawSql:
select $__timeGroupAlias(ts, 1h), label as metric, count(*) as failures from connect_failure join device_label using (device_id)
where $__timeFilter(ts) and device_id in ($device) group by 1, 2 order by 1

panels.title: Recent connect failures

targets.rawSql:
select ts, label as device, search_sec, age_sec, ceer, cgatt, cops,
       band, dl_mhz, tac, cell_id, pci, rsrp_dbm, sinr, raw
from connect_failures join device_label using (device_id) where $__timeFilter(ts) and device_id in ($device) order by ts desc limit 200

panels.description: AT dump captured when the connect budget ran out, taken apart: CEER is the modem's reject cause, CGATT 0 = never attached, and band/cell/RSRP are what it was camped on at that moment (empty = no cell at all).

panels.title: Serving cell

targets.rawSql:
select ts as time, label as device, tac || ' / ' || cell_id as cell from connections join device_label using (device_id)
where $__timeFilter(ts) and device_id in ($device) order by ts

panels.description: TAC / E-UTRAN cell id the device attached through, per report. A colour change is a different cell; the same eNodeB with another sector differs only in the last two hex digits.

panels.title: Band

targets.rawSql:
select ts as time, label as device, 'B' || band || ' · ' || dl_mhz || ' MHz' as band from connections join device_label using (device_id)
where $__timeFilter(ts) and device_id in ($device) order by ts

panels.description: LTE band and downlink centre frequency (from the EARFCN) per report.

panels.title: Cells seen

targets.rawSql:
select tac, cell_id, enb, sector, pci, band, dl_mhz, bw_mhz, operator,
       count(*) as connections,
       count(distinct device_id) as devices,
       string_agg(distinct label, ', ' order by label) as device_names,
       round(avg(rsrp_dbm))::int as rsrp_dbm,
       min(rsrp_dbm) as rsrp_min,
       round(avg(sinr)::numeric, 1) as sinr,
       max(ts) as last_seen
from connections join device_label using (device_id)
where $__timeFilter(ts) and device_id in ($device)
group by 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8, 9 order by connections desc

panels.description: Every cell the selected devices attached through in the time range, with how often and how well. rsrp_dbm/sinr are averages over those connections.

panels.title: Connections per cell, per day

targets.rawSql:
select $__timeGroupAlias(ts, 1d), tac || '/' || cell_id as metric, count(*) from connections
where $__timeFilter(ts) and device_id in ($device) group by 1, 2 order by 1

panels.description: How the selected devices' connections split across cells, day by day.

panels.title: RSRP by band

targets.rawSql:
select ts as time, 'B' || band as metric, rsrp_dbm from connections
where $__timeFilter(ts) and device_id in ($device) order by ts

panels.description: Every connection's RSRP, coloured by band. Shows whether the modem's band choice is costing signal.

panels.title: Connections

targets.rawSql:
select ts, label as device, operator, band, dl_mhz, bw_mhz, tac, cell_id, enb, sector, pci,
       rsrp_dbm, rsrq_db, sinr, os_rsrp_dbm
from connections join device_label using (device_id)
where $__timeFilter(ts) and device_id in ($device) order by ts desc limit 1000

panels.description: One row per report: serving cell and frequency from the modem's +UCGED, operator and the OS's own RSRP from the diagnostics of the same wake cycle. Newest 1000 in the range.

targets.rawSql:
select ts as time, label as metric, battery from telemetry join device_label using (device_id)
where $__timeFilter(ts) and device_id in ($device) order by ts

select ts as time, label as metric, vbat_idle from telemetry join device_label using (device_id)
where $__timeFilter(ts) and device_id in ($device) order by ts

panels.title: Webhook errors per hour, by cause

targets.rawSql:
select $__timeGroupAlias(ts, 1h),
       coalesce(substring(message from 'from (.*)$'), message) as metric,
       count(*) as errors
from hook_event where kind = 'error' and $__timeFilter(ts) group by 1, 2 order by 1

panels.description: hook-error events grouped by the host (or Particle's own message) that produced them.

panels.title: Webhook deliveries per hour

targets.rawSql:
select $__timeGroupAlias(ts, 1h), kind as metric, count(*) from hook_event
where hook = 'telemetry' and $__timeFilter(ts) group by 1, 2 order by 1

panels.description: For the telemetry hook: sent vs. response (delivered) vs. error. sent counts every configured integration, so it is a multiple of the telemetry rows.

targets.rawSql:
select fw_version, count(*) as devices, string_agg(label, ', ' order by label) as device_names
from device_label join device using (device_id) group by 1 order by 1 desc

panels.title: Resets & flashes

targets.rawSql:
select ts, label as device, name as event, data from other_event join device_label using (device_id)
where $__timeFilter(ts) and device_id in ($device) order by ts desc limit 100

panels.description: spark/device/last_reset, spark/flash/status and app-hash events.
